issue.body:
A recent AWS SDK upgrade has introduced a new source of spurious `WARN`
logs when the security manager prevents access to the user's home
directory and therefore to `$HOME/.aws/config`. This is the behaviour we
want, and it's harmless and handled by the SDK as if the config doesn't
exist, so this log message is unnecessary noise.  This commit suppresses
this noisy logging by default.

Relates #20313, #56346, #53962
Closes #62493

body: Thanks for the report @dunkelbunt1. This is just unnecessary noise emitted by the AWS SDK and you can safely ignore it. I opened #62522 to suppress this logging in future.

body: @dunkelbunt1 If you're as annoyed about this logfile spam as I am, add this line in the es-setup when the file permissions are set: `touch config/certs/aws-config-file`, and then set the environment of e.g. es01 to `AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/usr/share/elasticsearch/config/certs/aws-config-file`
